engine_semantics.position_change: PROWIMd also changes Xp from -.23 to -.201 m; it is not only spin reversal.
engine_semantics.unused_channel: No engine declares KPeng2. Current API rejects powers key2. Adapter must preserve !E2 333 as unused source-command provenance and explicitly map active key1, never assign333 to engine2.
engine_semantics.historical_handling: Shared channel semantics and ±1 Nm paired attachment jumps support500W per engine; exact original handling of the unused command is not recovered.

field_contract.t: Printed material coordinate, paired half-last-place .005 m. Retain raw row and index, not a full-precision recovered grid.
field_contract.y: Aircraft/body span position, paired half-last-place .0005 m. Original plotting uses y/.64 (=2y/full geometric span); do not divide by full1.28.
field_contract.z-z0: Nodal body z displacement in m.
field_contract.tw-tw0: Nodal Euler twist change in degrees.
field_contract.Mc'/10,Ms'/10,Fn/10: Local c,s moments in N m and local n force in N; multiply raw fields by their own printed powers of10 from header line31 only.
field_contract.cl: Local cl_perpendicular=2Gamma/(chord*Vperp), not whole-wing CL or a coefficient normalized by freestream alone. Derived interval quantity shifted upward one-half line; retain final dummy zero explicitly.
field_contract.f_aero: Unpaired PROWIN only: normal aerodynamic force per span, N/m, a derived shifted interval field.
field_contract.a_flap: All observed values zero, consistent with Flap1=0. Preserve rows; the reviewed primary displayed-variable list does not define this extra column sampling or units independently, so do not infer a nonzero-control recovery formula.
field_contract.node_mapping: Counts and known root/engine duplicates are consistent with original NODE/I150 structural outputs; missing saved display/startup state prevents proof of exact interpolation mode or unrounded grid. No fitting to printed coordinates.
field_contract.duplicates: Keep both one-sided rows at -0.3,0,+0.3 and all rounded duplicate coordinates. Do not collapse by rounded t/y or mistake every rounded duplicate for a physical jump.

normalization.reference_override: None: preserve literal halfspan-derived Reference values; no normalization repair.

normalization.coefficient_mapping: Source-supported prospective mapping: Lift/CL from distributed_aero_force projected on(-sin alpha,0,cos alpha); aerodynamic drag/CD from the freestream projection excluding engines. Header arithmetic proves direct total-force CD is unsuitable; exact historical exporter code is unavailable. Preserve net force/moment separately. Cm uses moment_y/(q*Sref*Cref); efficiency uses Trefftz CLi/CYi, not necessarily printed avgCL.
normalization.mach: Full span headers explicitly report MachPG0.000; physical Mach0.1470 is separate. Use PG0 for these paired states; do not inherit SA11 MachNone.
normalization.efficiency: Reference span is .64 despite full mirrored1.28 geometry. Values above1 are not an input error or grounds for clamping.

Original full-span model geometry and PG0
blockers: PROWIMd explicit dCLda=0 at both knots is rejected by aero.py:321. No source proof establishes zero as a default sentinel; do not replace with5.72 or2pi.

SourceCoupledNetwork rejects engines (source_coupled.py:34). Current solve_rigid has no internal Mc/Ms/Fn or structural endpoint traces. A complete source-equation full-row comparison requires engine support/recovery; legacy mounted StaticNetwork is a separate conditional operator route needing exact trace audit.
Generic polar adapter does not forward powers and assumes seven global polar fields. AP1 requires dedicated output/engine mapping; existing ST3 span loader also hardcodes incompatible exponents.
Original K/F influence/jet direction, core/startup sidecars and exact unrounded node/display mapping are unrecovered. No historical full-state reproduction claim is possible from count alone.
PROWIN.txt has no matching driver write; its ±6 Nm engine moment jumps differ from paired ±1 Nm and cannot be silently assigned the500W cases. PROWIM.t lacks alpha/power/output-pair context.

proposed_adapter_plan.first_step: Dedicated stdlib AP1 decoder/canonical plan preserving all rows, tokens, exponents, headers, source driver commands and explicit blocked outputs. Audit legacy mounted endpoint recovery or implement source engine coupling before claiming all fields executable.
